0022600009.text: The Spurs (0-1, 4th in the Southwest and 1 game back, 10th in the West) host the Houston Rockets (1-0, 1st in the Southwest, 3rd in the West) in San Antonio's second game of the season, after a loss in their opener. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance, who is out after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision, while Houston's Steven Adams is also day-to-day with calf soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have no 2026-27 meetings yet, but the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 145-120 win in San Antonio on March 8, 2026.
